description: depth_basis value descriptive_other has no definition
fixed_if: it is defined (comment or instructions), or removed

description: explicit_fraction_or_percentage is documented as depth and thickness, but nothing asks for both or says they must come from the same section
fixed_if: the instructions require both numbers and that they come from the same section or measurement, or forbid computing a fraction
partly_if: only one of: both numbers required; same section required

description: report wording that describes extent in the myometrium with no half, no number and no invasion word maps to no value
fixed_if: the instructions name this kind of wording and say which value it gets
partly_if: the instructions say what to do with wording that fits no listed kind, without naming this kind

description: no value is named for a depth of exactly one-half, or wording such as about one-half
fixed_if: the contract says which value takes exactly 50% or about one-half

description: specimen_type other_or_not_stated mixes a quotable meaning (other) with an unquotable one (not stated)
fixed_if: the two meanings are separated, or the contract says what to quote for each
partly_if: it is defined, without saying what to quote when nothing is stated

description: when two definitive statements give different depths, nothing says which wins
fixed_if: the contract says which statement wins (for example the deepest)
